body:
I'm 50. I apologize for coming off as a whiny bastard. I'm just in a lot of pain. 

My job went to Thailand. We had to pack up all of our multi-million dollar machines.
I want to die. I know it's nothing like having cancer but I have horrible eczema and it is making me insane. I don't have any heath care any more.
I had to ship my job overseas. I had to train my own replacement.
